title: Support zero copy file transferring for IoUring transport.

comments.body: @doxlik have you tried modifying your own build of vertx to make this work ? I can see that io uring file region are created by AbstractIoUringStreamChannel#filterOutboundMessage that automatically turns default file region into uri file region when enabled
I'm wondering also whether vertx transport should not return `IoUring.isSpliceSupported()` instead

You’re right. The relevant code in VertxConnection#sendFileRegion causes the reference count of DefaultFileRegion to never reach 0. For the NIO/epoll implementations, vertx will close file However, for the io_uring implementation, it doesn’t rely solely on the FileChannel; it depends on FileChannel + pipefd. The pipefd is closed based on the ref-count mechanism of DefaultFileRegion / IoUringFileRegion. Because of this, the Vert.x implementation here results in a resource leak. I’m preparing a PR to try enabling io_uring sendfile support and to fix this resource leak issue.
